item.title: #536 How to Win at Business with Storytelling – TERENCE BARRY on the Power of Belief
item.description: Terence Barry came a long way from the automotive industry via several years doing storytelling in Hollywood and now with his own company, Brand and Story. So this podcast episode is a special one. “Ultimately business is about belief.” – so Terence Barry in our talk.

item.title: #537 Why is Employer Branding Without Culture an Illusion, CLAUDIA TATTANELLI?
item.description: In this SAATKORN podcast episode, I’m talking to Claudia Tattanelli, founder of C-YourCulture and one of the most experienced global minds in employer branding and culture strategy. Claudia has spent almost three decades shaping the employer branding industry – from her time at Universum to building her own consultancy focused on authentic culture work. One quote that truly hit me: “If you promise something you can’t live internally, you’re doing yourself a disservice.

item.title: #538 How Does a Data Powerhouse Reinvent Itself in the Age of AI, ANNIKA IN DER BEEK?
item.description: In this episode of SAATKORN, I’m talking to Annika in der Beek, Chief People Officer at Statista. After leading People topics during hypergrowth at About You, she’s now building a global HR function from the ground up—right in the middle of massive AI disruption.

item.title: #539 How is AI transforming global talent migration, Dr. MATTHIAS MAUCH?
item.description: In this episode of the SAATKORN Podcast, I’m talking to Dr. Matthias Mauch, Managing Director Germany at TERN, a company building technology to accelerate global talent migration. TERN combines AI-powered recruiting with complex immigration and integration processes to connect skilled workers from around the world with employers in Germany. item.title: #540 How Do You Stay Relevant in a World Where AI Questions Your Identity, ALI MAHLODJI?
item.description: In this SAATKORN podcast episode, I’m talking to Ali Mahlodji – Business Humanist, Leadership Mentor, former refugee, school dropout, corporate manager, teacher, author – and one of the most inspiring voices when it comes to personal transformation. Ali’s journey alone is powerful. But what really hit me was this idea: “Your life can change in one second – either through a crisis or through inspiration.

item.title: #541 How Can Europe Turn AI Into a Competitive Advantage – and which Role plays HR, MARC COLEMAN?
item.description: In this episode of the SAATKORN Podcast, I’m talking to Marc Coleman, Founder & CEO of Unleash – one of the world’s leading HR tech events in Paris and Las Vegas. Marc has been building Unleash since 2011 – from a small HR Tech event in Amsterdam to a global platform with over 10,000 attendees per year.

item.title: #542 How Dangerous Is AI in Recruiting – and What Do We Keep Ignoring, PROF KATHARINA ZWEIG?
item.description: In this SAATKORN podcast episode, I’m talking to Katharina Zweig, one of Germany’s most renowned AI experts, professor of computer science and head of the Algorithm Accountability Lab at RPTU. She combines deep technical expertise with societal responsibility – and challenges the hype around AI with refreshing clarity. One statement really stuck with me: “AI does not know that it knows nothing – we just interpret intelligence into it.”
